﻿
I'd love to see more recolours of furniture from the new catalogues and thought I'd share my library of
assets so all people need to do is edit the colours, zip it up and upload it~!

No need to make your own content or manifests for thoese not code savvy, it's all included.

[b][u]How to Use:[/u][/b]

[size=2]1. Download the file and unzip.
2. Pick which you want to make, either AT, CP version or both~
3. Open the image into an editing program that allows transparent backgrounds. (I myself use paint.net)
4. Make some fabulous colour changes!
5. Edit the manifest(s) with your own information.
6. Save it, zip it and upload it.
7. Link your recolour in the comments, I'd love to see them~!

[u][b]TIP:[/b][/u] Even if you're only doing the AT version, I find editing the asset sheets in the CP folder keeps the design cohesive.
Then you just have to copypaste the individual furniture to the files for Alternative Textures~

If you change the images name in the CP version, be sure to edit the content line [b]FromFile[/b] to match the new name.
[/size]
